coverage_summary.difference_from_starting_claim: Current GC4 artifacts report 10 missing mappings; 20 was the earlier post-GC3 count.

findings.title: Higher-timeframe scanner can include unclosed H4/M15 candles
findings.evidence: _window_asof_indexed uses bisect_right(times, asof), and scan_history passes the current M3 timestamp as asof for H4/M15 windows.
findings.reproduction: Run scan_history with H4 open-time candles and inspect H4 windows for an M3 asof inside an H4 interval.
findings.expected: H4/M15 windows include only closed candles at the M3 decision time.
findings.actual: Bars with timestamp <= M3 asof are included, regardless of higher-timeframe close.
findings.impact: Invalidates closed-candle/no-lookahead evidence and signal timing.
findings.recommended_remediation: Define timestamp semantics and slice H4/M15 using close times <= asof.
findings.tests_required: Intra-H4/M15 negative cutoff tests and exact signal reproduction after correction.

findings.title: FVG chain can pass without required HTF FVG overlap
findings.evidence: FVG validity is mf_fvg != None and ltf_fvg != None; HTF FVG may be absent.
findings.reproduction: Construct MF and LTF overlapping FVGs with no overlapping H4 FVG and call EvidenceBuilder.build_fvg_chain.
findings.expected: HTF FVG valid -> MF overlap -> LTF within MF displacement is required.
findings.actual: MF+LTF evidence can be valid without HTF evidence.
findings.recommended_remediation: Require HTF FVG and explicit cascade rejection evidence.
findings.tests_required: Missing-HTF, non-overlap, and full-chain golden cases.

findings.title: Liquidity sweep max-age is evaluated at sweep time, not decision cutoff
findings.evidence: age is i - pool source index, and the earliest confirmed sweep is returned without current-cutoff age validation.
findings.reproduction: Create a valid sweep, append more than max_age H4 bars, and call structural_context.
findings.expected: Sweep age is valid relative to the current decision window.
findings.actual: Historically valid sweeps can remain eligible later.
findings.recommended_remediation: Check age at current cutoff and select a deterministic current eligible sweep.
findings.tests_required: Age 20 pass, age 21 fail, multiple-sweep selection cases.

findings.title: Signal timestamp can differ from actual LTF confirmation timestamp
findings.evidence: detect_ltf_confirmation returns the first qualifying confirmation in the window, while analyze_windows stamps the signal at ltf[-1].
findings.reproduction: Append non-confirming bars after a valid LTF CHoCH and compare confirmation_timestamp with signal_time.
findings.expected: Signal timing follows first qualifying confirmation or a documented entry-window candidate rule.
findings.actual: Signal timing follows the last bar of the window.
findings.impact: Duplicate-signal and existence timestamp evidence are unreliable.
findings.recommended_remediation: Separate confirmation, entry-window, duplicate, and expiry semantics.
findings.tests_required: First-bar, duplicate later-window, and expiry golden cases.

findings.title: Logical trade plan collapses T1 and T2 into one target
findings.evidence: target_1 and target_2 both use the same target_price.
findings.reproduction: Inspect a confirmed LogicalTradePlan from DecisionEvidenceBuilder.
findings.expected: T1 and T2 are separately evidenced or the mapping remains incomplete.
findings.actual: One target is duplicated into both fields.
findings.recommended_remediation: Model separate T1/T2 evidence or mark target evidence incomplete.
findings.tests_required: Distinct target, missing T1, and missing T2 tests.

findings.title: Exact audited SHA has failing CI
findings.reproduction: View GitHub Actions run 30110038467 or run python -m pytest -q in the CI checkout.
findings.expected: Exact audited SHA has passing CI.
findings.actual: CI failed with 1 failed, 214 passed, 4 skipped.
findings.recommended_remediation: Make existence data/report reproducible in CI or mark honestly data-blocked.

findings.title: Baseline open-PR claim is stale
findings.evidence: gh pr list returned one open PR.
findings.expected: Audit baseline matches verified repository state.
findings.actual: Starting claim said zero open PRs.
findings.impact: Repository-state evidence would be inaccurate if not reverified.
findings.recommended_remediation: Update status/audit baseline when PR state changes.

findings.title: Requirements are unpinned and environments diverge
findings.evidence: requirements.txt lists pytest, pandas, PyYAML without versions; local and CI package versions differ.
findings.reproduction: Compare requirements.txt, CI install log, and local pip freeze.
findings.impact: Validation output may vary by machine.
findings.recommended_remediation: Pin constraints or declare supported validation environment.
findings.tests_required: CI and local reproduction under pinned environment.

findings.title: Existence reproduction command rewrites tracked evidence
findings.evidence: REPORT_PATH is the canonical tracked report and build_report writes it.
findings.expected: Pure reproduction does not mutate tracked evidence by default.
findings.impact: Audit runs can mutate evidence files.
findings.recommended_remediation: Separate pure check from report writer or require explicit output path.
